topics.question: What is the minimum wage and what allowances must an employer pay?
topics.source: Ministry of Labour and Social Security
topics.sourceTitle: The Employment Code (Minimum Wages and Conditions of Employment) (General) Order, 2023 (SI No. 48 of 2023)
topics.context: The general order sets the lowest pay and the allowances for protected employees. Shop workers and truck and bus drivers have their own orders, SI 50 of 2023 and SI 3 of 2025.
topics.status: Minimum wages change by statutory instrument. Check for an order later than 2025, and check which order covers the job before relying on a figure.

topics.question: A new Immigration Control Act was passed in 2026. Which law governs my work permit today?
topics.context: Read the new Act beside the Immigration and Deportation Act, 2010, which is the one the Department of Immigration has been applying.
topics.status: The 2026 Act starts on a date the Minister appoints by statutory instrument, and no commencement order is recorded here. Check the Gazette before relying on either Act.

topics.question: Must I get planning permission before building, and what is the penalty for developing land without it?
topics.sourceTitle: The Urban and Regional Planning Act, 2015 (No. 3 of 2015)
topics.context: Section 49 carries the rule, the offence and the planning authority's power to demolish without compensation. This Act replaced the Town and Country Planning Act.
topics.status: Councils apply their own plans and by-laws on top of the Act, and the value of a penalty unit is set by statutory instrument. Confirm local requirements with your council.

topics.question: What NAPSA contribution must an employer pay and what is the penalty for late payment?
topics.context: The Act says who must contribute, who pays it over and what happens when payment is late. The rate itself and the earnings ceiling are set separately by statutory instrument.
topics.status: A National Pension Scheme Act, 2026 has been passed but starts on a date the President appoints, and no commencement order is recorded here. Cap. 256 is the law for now.

topics.question: What must an employer do to keep a workplace safe, and who inspects it?
topics.sourceTitle: The Occupational Health and Safety Act, 2025 (No. 16 of 2025)
topics.context: The 2025 Act replaced the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 2010. It sets the employer's duties, when a workplace needs a health and safety committee, and what an inspector may do.
topics.status: Regulations made under the Act can add duties for particular industries. Check for statutory instruments made since 2025.

topics.question: How does someone apply for a protection order under the Anti-Gender-Based Violence Act?
topics.source: Ministry of Community Development and Social Services
topics.context: Section 10 lets a victim apply to a court for a protection order against a respondent, an associated respondent, or both, and the Act sets out what the court can order.
topics.status: Court practice, forms and fees differ between courts. If you are in danger now, contact the police Victim Support Unit or a One Stop Centre first.
